environment.timing_notes: CPU-only Python wall-clock timings; storage device model and background load are not controlled.

measurement_scope.proof_microbenchmark_notes: Inclusion benchmarks verify the middle event against a committed root. Consistency benchmarks use an old tree of floor(n/2) events and a new tree of n events; internal verification checks against the new event list, while external verification checks the signed proof object and key registry only. The artifact does not yet measure long-lived rolling logs or many successive consistency proofs over multi-commit trajectories.
